source.conversion: ARPAbet to General American IPA, stress marks before the stressed syllable (maximal onset); several pronunciations: a row of packages/db/src/vocab/ipa-heteronyms.ts; else another syllable count -> null; another primary-stress syllable -> the earlier for a noun or adjective, the later for a verb, null otherwise; one syllable -> the fewest reduced vowels (AH0, IH0, ER0; first on a tie); two or more -> the first variant left.
